regime_context: The detector shows Big Banks as the dominant eligible theme, with full breadth and high durability (0.74) but crowded (z=1.59). The absolute-trend gate is a validated risk-control edge (gate_helps=true) but cross-sectional momentum is not predictive. Rotation is broad with a wide leader-challenger margin (0.802) over Pipelines; no one-narrative extreme or confirmed handoff.
emerging_watch: Watch for a potential rotation from Big Banks to Pipelines & Midstream if the leader-challenger margin narrows below 0.35 and Pipelines’ durability improves above 0.75. Kill criterion: margin widens back above 0.6 or Big Banks’ durability increases further.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Despite crowding, Big Banks show strong trend-gate eligibility, high durability, and full breadth, suggesting the trend regime is intact and the gate is helping control shake-out risk. Crowding is only a size caution, not a fade signal.
theses.dissent: Crowding and high absorption (0.36) raise reversal risk; the trend gate reduces but does not eliminate drawdowns, and a macro shift (e.g. housing stress) could force unwinds.

falsifier.text: Big Banks become ineligible on the absolute trend gate (eligible flips to false).

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Despite passing the absolute trend gate, the theme exhibits mean-reverting dynamics (hurst), low durability (0.53), and only modest breadth (0.533), reducing confidence in trend continuation.
theses.dissent: A geopolitical supply disruption could ignite a sustained oil-price uptrend that overcomes the mean-reverting tendency and lifts breadth.

falsifier.text: Breadth rises above 0.75 and the hurst tag shifts to 'trend' for at least 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: While eligible and broadly held (high breadth), the theme’s mean-reverting hurst tag and low durability score (0.56) paint a picture of a weakening trend, not a reliable continuer.
theses.dissent: A sharp risk-off rotation into defensives could rapidly strengthen the trend, reversing the mean-reverting character and raising durability.

falsifier.text: Durability bar rises above 0.7 and hurst tag shifts to 'trend'.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
